chemistry-m3-q2.title: Budada copper ayaa lagu
chemistry-m3-q2.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-m3-q2.material: Budada copper ayaa lagu shubay crucible oo hawada lagu kululeeyay si loo sameeyo copper(II) oxide. Marka 4 g oo copper ah si buuxda u falgalay, waxaa soo baxay 5 g oo copper(II) oxide ah. Waa maxay cufka oxygen-ka ku xidhmay iyo saamiga cufka copper iyo oxygen?
chemistry-m3-q2.s.s1.prompt: Budada copper ayaa lagu shubay crucible oo hawada lagu kululeeyay si loo sameeyo copper(II) oxide. Marka 4 g oo copper ah si buuxda u falgalay, waxaa soo baxay 5 g oo copper(II) oxide ah. Waa maxay cufka oxygen-ka ku xidhmay iyo saamiga cufka copper iyo oxygen?
chemistry-m3-q2.s.s1.explain: Cufka oxygen-ka falgalay waa $5\text{ g} - 4\text{ g} = 1\text{ g}$. Sida uu sheegayo sharciga saamiga joogtada ah, saamiga cufka copper iyo oxygen ee ka dhigan copper(II) oxide had iyo jeer waa $4 : 1$.

chemistry-m3-q2.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

chemistry-m3-q3.title: Marka heerkulka iyo cadaadisku
chemistry-m3-q3.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-m3-q3.material: Marka heerkulka iyo cadaadisku isku mid yihiin, gaaska hydrogen iyo gaaska oxygen waxay falgalaan si ay u sameeyaan uumi biyood. Waa maxay 'saamiga mugga' saxda ah ee hydrogen, oxygen iyo uumiga la sameeyay? (Sharciga falgalka gaaska)
chemistry-m3-q3.s.s1.prompt: Marka heerkulka iyo cadaadisku isku mid yihiin, gaaska hydrogen iyo gaaska oxygen waxay falgalaan si ay u sameeyaan uumi biyood. Waa maxay 'saamiga mugga' saxda ah ee hydrogen, oxygen iyo uumiga la sameeyay? (Sharciga falgalka gaaska)

chemistry-m3-q3.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

chemistry-m3-q4.title: Kuwee ayaa si sax
chemistry-m3-q4.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-m3-q4.material: Kuwee ayaa si sax ah isugu xiraya tamarta soo gasha iyo ka baxda ee hot pack-ka la gilgilo ee xilliga qaboobaha (falgalka oxidation ee budada birta) iyo cold pack-ka lagu daaweeyo foorarka degdegga ah (falgalka ammonium nitrate iyo biyaha)?

chemistry-m3-c.title: [Coefficients-ka falgalka ee heerka
chemistry-m3-c.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-m3-c.material: [Coefficients-ka falgalka ee heerka sare] Marka gaaska propane (C₃H₈) uu la gubto oxygen (O₂) si buuxda, waxaa soo baxa carbon dioxide (CO₂) iyo biyo (H₂O). Isleegga kiimikada ee isu dheellitiran C₃H₈ + a O₂ → b CO₂ + c H₂O, waa maxay wadarta coefficients-ka (a, b, c) ee (a + b + c)?

Isleegga kiimikada ee isu dheellitiran C₃H₈ + a O₂ → b CO₂ + c H₂O, waa maxay wadarta coefficients-ka (a, b, c) ee (a + b + c)?
chemistry-m3-c.s.s1.explain: Isleegga kiimikada ee isu dheellitiran waa $\text{C}_3\text{H}_8 + 5\text{O}_2 \rightarrow 3\text{CO}_2 + 4\text{H}_2\text{O}$. Sidaa darteed coefficients-ku waa $a=5, b=3, c=4$, wadarta-na waa $5 + 3 + 4 = 12$.

chemistry-m3-q5.title: Hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) wuxuu
chemistry-m3-q5.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-m3-q5.material: Hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) wuxuu si aad u gaabis ah ugu kala jabaa biyo iyo oxygen heerkulka qolka. Marka budo yar oo madow oo manganese dioxide (MnO₂) ah lagu daro, xumbo (gaaska oxygen) ayaa si xoog leh u soo baxay. Waa maxay doorka manganese dioxide?
chemistry-m3-q5.s.s1.prompt: Hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) wuxuu si aad u gaabis ah ugu kala jabaa biyo iyo oxygen heerkulka qolka. Marka budo yar oo madow oo manganese dioxide (MnO₂) ah lagu daro, xumbo (gaaska oxygen) ayaa si xoog leh u soo baxay. Waa maxay doorka manganese dioxide?

chemistry-killer-09.title: Heerkul iyo cadaadis joogto
chemistry-killer-09.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-09.material: Heerkul iyo cadaadis joogto ah, falgalka $\mathrm{aA(g) + bB(g) \rightarrow cC(g)}$ ee gaaska A iyo B ay falgalaan si ay u sameeyaan gaaska C, A 20 mL iyo B 60 mL ayaa si buuxda u falgalay oo sameeyay C 40 mL. Culeyska molecule ee A waa 28, ka B waa 2, 100 mL oo isku-darka gaaska A iyo B ah (celceliska culeyska molecule 12.4) ayaa si buuxda loo falgaliyay heerkul iyo cadaadis isku mid ah. Cufnaanta isku-darka gaaska kadib falgalka waa imisa jibaar cufnaanta kahor falgalka?
chemistry-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: Heerkul iyo cadaadis joogto ah, falgalka $\mathrm{aA(g) + bB(g) \rightarrow cC(g)}$ ee gaaska A iyo B ay falgalaan si ay u sameeyaan gaaska C, A 20 mL iyo B 60 mL ayaa si buuxda u falgalay oo sameeyay C 40 mL. Culeyska molecule ee A waa 28, ka B waa 2, 100 mL oo isku-darka gaaska A iyo B ah (celceliska culeyska molecule 12.4) ayaa si buuxda loo falgaliyay heerkul iyo cadaadis isku mid ah. Cufnaanta isku-darka gaaska kadib falgalka waa imisa jibaar cufnaanta kahor falgalka?
chemistry-killer-09.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabo 1: Saamiga mugga A:B:C = 20:60:40 = 1:3:2, taasoo ah $\mathrm{A + 3B \rightarrow 2C}$.
Tallaabo 2: 100 mL oo isku-darka gaaska ah, mugga A waa x: (28x + 2(100 − x))/100 = 12.4 → 26x + 200 = 1240 → x = 40 mL. Sidaa darteed A 40 mL, B 60 mL.
Tallaabo 3: Haddii B 60 mL dhammaantiis falgasho, A 20 mL ayaa la isticmaalaa C 40 mL-na waa la sameeyaa. Kadib falgalka A 20 mL + C 40 mL = 60 mL.
Tallaabo 4: Cufku wuu ilaaliyaa (hubin cufka molecule-ka: kahor falgalka 40×28 + 60×2 = 1240, kadib falgalka culeyska molecule ee C (28+3×2)/2 = 17, 20×28 + 40×17 = 1240). Heerkul iyo cadaadis isku mid ah cufnaanta = cuf/mug, sidaa darteed kadib/kahor = 100/60 = 5/3.
Jawaab: 5/3 (a). (Jawaabaha khaldan: 3/5 waa saamiga oo rogan, 1 wuxuu eegay ilaalinta cufka oo kaliya isagoo iska indho tiray isbeddelka mugga, 5/4 wuxuu si qalad ah u arkay in A 40 mL hadhay oo wuxuu xisaabiyay wadar 80 mL.)
chemistry-killer-09.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-09.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
